project.name: huly-platform
project.description: The Huly Platform — an open-source framework for business applications (Chat, Project Management, CRM, HRM, ATS). Built on a transaction-sourced data model (Doc/Class/Tx), a plugin/resource platform, and a WebSocket client-server protocol, with a Svelte UI and pluggable storage backends.

nodes.name: base64.ts

nodes.name: config.ts

nodes.name: error.ts

nodes.name: ApiError

nodes.name: index.ts

nodes.name: integrations.ts

nodes.name: mutex.ts
nodes.summary: In-memory keyed mutex providing per-key serialized locking plus a shared set of recently synced identifiers.

nodes.name: getTokenByEvent
nodes.summary: Resolves the integration token associated with a given event's owner within a workspace.

nodes.name: pushHandler.ts
nodes.summary: Handles inbound Google Calendar push notifications by resolving the affected workspace/user and triggering an incoming sync.

nodes.name: PushHandler
nodes.summary: Receives Google push notification headers, maps them to a user/calendar, and kicks off an incoming sync run.

nodes.summary: Token-bucket style rate limiter with a per-user factory used to throttle Google Calendar API requests.

nodes.name: RateLimiter

nodes.name: createServer

nodes.name: IncomingSyncManager
nodes.summary: Manages full and incremental incoming synchronization of Google calendars and events into Huly, tracking history tokens and reconciling created/updated/deleted entities.

nodes.name: tokens.ts
nodes.summary: Helper for retrieving the set of workspace integration tokens used by the calendar pod.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared type definitions and the Google OAuth SCOPES constant used throughout the calendar pod.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Grab-bag of shared helpers for the calendar pod: token/service-token generation, Google client setup, recurrence rule (RFC5545) encoding, date conversion, and user/email integration management.

nodes.name: DeferredPromise
nodes.summary: Promise wrapper exposing externally-callable resolve/reject handles for deferred completion.

nodes.name: parseRecurrenceString

nodes.name: encodeRecurringRuleToRFC5545
nodes.summary: Encodes a structured recurrence rule into an RFC5545 RRULE string for Google Calendar.

nodes.name: getGoogleClient
nodes.summary: Creates and configures a Google OAuth2 client from the pod's configured credentials.

nodes.name: removeUserByEmail
nodes.summary: Removes the user/email association for an integration as part of sign-out or cleanup.

nodes.name: WatchClient
nodes.summary: Subscribes to and unsubscribes from Google Calendar watch channels for a user's calendars and events.

nodes.name: WatchController
nodes.summary: Singleton controller that periodically renews expiring Google Calendar watch subscriptions across all integrations.

nodes.name: workspaceClient.ts
nodes.summary: Per-workspace client that loads calendar metadata and participants and coordinates incoming sync managers and calendar clients for each integration in the workspace.

nodes.name: WorkspaceClient
nodes.summary: Loads workspace calendar/participant state and runs sync for each integration, bridging Huly workspace data with Google calendar clients.

nodes.name: blob.ts

nodes.languageNotes: Uses promise-deduplication maps to coalesce concurrent group-creation and fetch requests.

nodes.name: client.ts
nodes.summary: Defines LowLevelClient providing cached access to message metadata and person UUID lookups by social ID over the workspace data lake.

nodes.name: error.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the ApiError class with factory constructors for common HTTP error codes and JSON serialization support.

nodes.name: Blob
nodes.summary: Manages message-group blobs for a card: fetches and caches groups, creates new groups by date, and applies JSON patches for message inserts/updates, reactions, attachments, and threads.

nodes.name: LowLevelClient
nodes.summary: Low-level data client that caches message metadata and resolves person UUIDs from social IDs via the account client and workspace data lake.

nodes.name: ApiError
nodes.summary: Error subclass carrying an HTTP status code with static factories for bad-request, forbidden, and not-found errors plus JSON serialization.

nodes.name: matchDate
nodes.summary: Evaluates a date against a comparison filter (greater, greaterOrEqual, less, lessOrEqual, equal, notEqual) used when querying message groups.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public entry point of the communication server package; defines the Api class that wires together the DB adapter, blob storage and middleware chain to expose query and event operations.

nodes.name: Api
nodes.summary: Top-level API facade that constructs the middleware chain via buildMiddlewares and delegates find/event/subscribe/close operations to it.

nodes.name: messageId.ts
nodes.summary: Generates monotonic, time-based message identifiers using a high-resolution clock to ensure ordered unique IDs.

nodes.name: getMonotonicTick10us
nodes.summary: Returns a monotonically increasing 10-microsecond tick derived from process.hrtime to back unique message IDs.

nodes.name: metadata.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves runtime configuration metadata (such as message group size limits) for the communication server.

nodes.name: base.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the BaseMiddleware abstract class implementing the chain-of-responsibility pattern that all communication middlewares extend.

nodes.name: BaseMiddleware
nodes.summary: Base middleware providing default pass-through provide* methods that forward find/event/broadcast operations to the next middleware in the chain.

nodes.name: broadcast.ts
nodes.summary: Broadcast middleware that tracks per-session card subscriptions and fans out matching events to subscribed clients.

nodes.name: BroadcastMiddleware
nodes.summary: Maintains session subscription state and dispatches broadcast events to clients whose subscriptions match the affected cards.

nodes.name: date.ts
nodes.summary: Middleware that stamps incoming events with a server-side date unless the request originates from a system account.

nodes.name: DateMiddleware
nodes.summary: Assigns the current date to events except those issued by system accounts that may supply their own.

nodes.name: id.ts
nodes.summary: Middleware that assigns a generated monotonic message ID to events that lack one before passing them along the chain.

nodes.name: IdMiddleware
nodes.summary: Generates and attaches message IDs to create-message events via generateMessageId before delegating downstream.

nodes.name: indentity.ts
nodes.summary: Identity middleware that enriches events and query params with the resolved account/person UUID for the calling social ID.

nodes.name: IdentityMiddleware
nodes.summary: Resolves person/account identity for events and find queries, injecting the account into params before forwarding.

nodes.name: peer.ts
nodes.summary: Peer middleware that tracks cards with peers and forwards events to peer heads for cross-instance synchronization.

nodes.name: PeerMiddleware
nodes.summary: Records cards that have peers and routes events to peer heads to keep distributed communication state in sync.

nodes.name: permissions.ts
nodes.summary: Authorization middleware enforcing per-event permission checks on social IDs, message authorship, accounts, and system/anonymous restrictions.

nodes.name: PermissionsMiddleware
nodes.summary: Validates event authorization, raising ApiError.forbidden/notFound when social IDs, message authors, or account types fail permission checks.

nodes.name: storage.ts
nodes.summary: Core persistence middleware that maps communication events to database and blob operations for messages, patches, attachments, threads, notifications, labels, and peers.

nodes.name: StorageMiddleware
nodes.summary: Dispatches each event kind to dedicated handlers that write messages, patches, attachments, threads, notifications, labels and peers to the DB and blob stores.

nodes.name: triggers.ts
nodes.summary: Triggers middleware that, after an event is processed, runs matching synchronous and async triggers and notifications, collecting derived events for broadcast.

nodes.name: TriggersMiddleware
nodes.summary: Executes registered triggers and notification handlers against processed events, applying derived events synchronously and via async requests.

nodes.name: validate.ts
nodes.summary: Validation middleware using Zod schemas to validate find queries and events, and helpers to deserialize incoming event payloads and dates.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Zod schema parsing with a branded-string helper to enforce nominal typing on validated fields.

nodes.name: ValidateMiddleware
nodes.summary: Validates find queries and each event kind against Zod schemas, raising ApiError.badRequest on failure before deserializing and forwarding.

nodes.name: deserializeEvent
nodes.summary: Converts a serialized event payload into its in-memory form, parsing embedded date strings into Date objects.

nodes.name: middlewares.ts
nodes.summary: Assembles and orchestrates the ordered middleware chain via buildMiddlewares and the Middlewares dispatcher that forwards all API operations to the chain head.

nodes.name: buildMiddlewares
nodes.summary: Constructs the ordered list of middleware factories (storage, validate, permissions, identity, date, id, triggers, broadcast, peer) and builds the chain.

nodes.name: Middlewares
nodes.summary: Builds the middleware chain and dispatches find/event/subscribe/close calls to the chain head, handling chain teardown on errors.

nodes.name: notification.ts
nodes.summary: Notification engine that derives notification events for messages and reactions, resolving collaborators, contexts, and read state.

nodes.name: notify
nodes.summary: Entry point that routes a communication event to message or reaction notification generation based on its kind.

nodes.name: removeReactionNotification
nodes.summary: Removes or adjusts notifications when a reaction is withdrawn, reconciling notification context state.

nodes.name: notifyReaction
nodes.summary: Generates notifications for a new reaction, respecting space membership and existing notification contexts.

nodes.name: notifyMessage
nodes.summary: Builds notifications for a new message by iterating card collaborators and their notification contexts.

nodes.name: processCollaborator
nodes.summary: Creates notification and context events for a single collaborator, deriving message preview text from markdown.

nodes.name: createOrUpdateContext
nodes.summary: Creates a new notification context or updates an existing one, factoring in read state and ownership.

nodes.name: createContext
nodes.summary: Executes creation of a notification context for an account and reloads the resulting context.

nodes.name: all.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module that aggregates and registers all card, message, and notification triggers for the communication server.

nodes.name: card.ts
nodes.summary: Card lifecycle triggers handling type updates, activity logging, and cascading cleanup of collaborators, labels, threads, and notification contexts on card removal.

nodes.name: createActivityOnCardTypeUpdate
nodes.summary: Emits an activity message when a card's type is changed.

nodes.name: onCardTypeUpdates
nodes.summary: Propagates a card type change to collaborators, labels, and thread metadata in the database.

nodes.name: removeCardThreads
nodes.summary: Removes thread metadata and blob threads associated with a card being deleted.

nodes.name: removeNotificationContexts
nodes.summary: Collects removal events for all notification contexts tied to a removed card.

nodes.name: message.ts
nodes.summary: Message triggers that resolve collaborators from mentions, maintain thread reply counts, propagate thread attachments, and synchronize peers.

nodes.name: addCollaborators
nodes.summary: Derives collaborators from message mentions and space members and emits add-collaborator events.

nodes.name: addThreadReply
nodes.summary: Increments thread reply state when a reply message is created in a thread.

nodes.name: onThreadAttached
nodes.summary: Generates derived messages and attachment patches when a thread is attached to a message.

nodes.name: checkPeers
nodes.summary: Fans out events to peer cards in the same workspace, deduplicating already-processed peer events.

nodes.name: notification.ts
nodes.summary: Notification triggers that react to collaborator add/remove, notification context updates, and message removals to keep notification state consistent.

nodes.name: onAddedCollaborators
nodes.summary: Emits a system message announcing newly added collaborators on a card.

nodes.name: onRemovedCollaborators
nodes.summary: Removes notification contexts and emits a message when collaborators are removed from a card.

nodes.name: onNotificationContextUpdated
nodes.summary: Derives follow-up events when a notification context is updated.

nodes.name: onMessagesRemoved
nodes.summary: Removes notifications grouped by context when their underlying messages are deleted.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Helper utilities for trigger logic that resolve display names by social ID and build collaborator add/remove message content.

nodes.name: getAddCollaboratorsMessageContent
nodes.summary: Builds a human-readable message describing collaborators added by a sender.

nodes.name: getRemoveCollaboratorsMessageContent
nodes.summary: Builds a human-readable message describing collaborators removed by a sender.

nodes.name: connect
nodes.summary: Builds a mock client connection that loads the minimal model and serves tx/findAll/model requests from an in-memory database for tests.

nodes.name: createModel
nodes.summary: Test helper that applies model transactions into hierarchy, model, and tx databases to assemble a populated in-memory model.

nodes.name: ClientModel
nodes.summary: Test client implementation backed by an in-memory model, exposing hierarchy/model accessors and find/search/domainRequest operations.

nodes.name: genMinModel
nodes.summary: Generates the full set of seed transactions defining a minimal test model with classes, interfaces, and documents.

nodes.name: updateDoc
nodes.summary: Builds a TxUpdateDoc transaction for the given class, space, object, and operations via the transaction factory.

nodes.name: setWorkspaceGuestAutoJoinRoles
nodes.summary: Returns a new auto-join roles array with the guest role added or removed based on the includeGuest flag, preserving existing roles immutably.

nodes.name: client.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the core Client implementation that wraps a transport connection, loads and builds the transaction-sourced model, and proxies findAll/tx/storage operations to either the local model or the remote backend.
nodes.languageNotes: Transaction-sourced architecture: the model is rebuilt by replaying model transactions through the Hierarchy and ModelDb.

nodes.name: ClientImpl
nodes.summary: Concrete Client wrapping a backend connection; serves queries from the in-memory model where possible, forwards transactions and document operations to the connection, and tracks applied model transactions for remote-update reconciliation.

nodes.name: createClient
nodes.summary: Factory that establishes a connection, loads/builds the model with optional persistence, buffers transactions during bootstrap, and returns a configured ClientImpl with reconnect handling.

nodes.name: loadModel
nodes.summary: Loads model transactions from persistence and the connection, comparing hashes to fetch only deltas, then stores the merged result back to persistence.

nodes.name: buildModel
nodes.summary: Replays filtered model transactions through the Hierarchy and ModelDb to construct the in-memory model.

nodes.name: clone.ts
nodes.summary: Provides deep-clone utilities with type detection, used to safely copy documents and mixins without sharing references.

nodes.name: getTypeOf
nodes.summary: Determines a precise runtime type tag for an object (array, date, plain object, etc.) to drive clone behavior.

nodes.name: clone
nodes.summary: Recursively deep-clones a value, preserving dates and arrays and applying optional mixin-transform callbacks.

nodes.name: collaboration.ts
nodes.summary: Helpers for constructing collaborative-document identifiers (collab IDs, Ydoc IDs, JSON IDs) tying a document attribute to a collaborative editing object.

nodes.name: collaborators.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves the configured collaborator attributes for a class by walking its ancestors in the model.

nodes.name: getClassCollaborators
nodes.summary: Looks up ClassCollaborators mixins across a class's ancestor chain and returns the most specific match.

nodes.name: component.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the core plugin: registers all core class, mixin, space, and system-account identifiers via the platform plugin/component system.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the Huly plugin() builder to declare a large namespaced identifier map consumed across the whole platform.

nodes.name: hierarchy.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the class Hierarchy: the central registry of classes, mixins, interfaces, attributes, ancestors, and descendants, with mixin proxying and transaction-driven schema updates.

nodes.name: Hierarchy
nodes.summary: Maintains the runtime class model — classifiers, attributes, ancestor/descendant maps — and exposes derivation checks, mixin casting (as/asIf), domain resolution, and transaction handlers that mutate the schema.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel entry point that re-exports the core package's public modules and the core plugin namespace.

nodes.name: memdb.ts
nodes.summary: In-memory document database supporting indexed lookup by class/id, query matching, lookups, associations, and transaction application; provides TxDb and ModelDb specializations.

nodes.name: TxDb
nodes.summary: MemDb variant that stores transactions as documents, indexing every applied tx for query and retrieval.

nodes.name: ModelDb
nodes.summary: MemDb variant holding the model objects, applying create/update/remove/mixin transactions and a batched addTxes path used during model build.

nodes.name: objvalue.ts
nodes.summary: Utilities for reading and writing nested document values by dotted key paths, including array-aware traversal used by queries and operators.

nodes.name: getObjectValue
nodes.summary: Resolves a dotted key path into a document, traversing nested objects and arrays to retrieve the target value.

nodes.name: setObjectValue
nodes.summary: Writes a value into a document at a dotted key path, creating intermediate nodes and handling array segments.

nodes.name: operations.ts
nodes.summary: High-level transaction operations API (TxOperations) for creating, updating, mixing-in, and removing documents, plus batched ApplyOperations and a TxBuilder, layered over the raw tx primitives.

nodes.name: TxOperations
nodes.summary: Ergonomic wrapper around a Client that builds and dispatches create/update/remove/mixin transactions, providing the primary write API for document operations.

nodes.name: ApplyOperations
nodes.summary: Accumulates a batch of transactions to be committed atomically as a single ApplyTx, with optional match/notify semantics.

nodes.name: TxBuilder
nodes.summary: Collects transactions into a list instead of dispatching them, used to assemble transaction sets for later application.

nodes.name: updateAttribute
nodes.summary: Builds and applies the correct update transaction for a single document attribute, accounting for mixins, collections, and operator-based updates.

nodes.name: operator.ts
nodes.summary: Implements document update operators ($push, $pull, $update, $inc, $unset, $rename) and a registry to resolve them when applying update transactions.

nodes.name: $push
nodes.summary: Applies the $push update operator, appending one or more elements to an array attribute with optional positioning.

nodes.name: $pull
nodes.summary: Applies the $pull update operator, removing matching elements from an array attribute.

nodes.name: $update
nodes.summary: Applies the $update operator to mutate array elements matching a query criterion.

nodes.name: $inc
nodes.summary: Applies the $inc operator, incrementing (or decrementing) a numeric attribute.

nodes.name: predicate.ts
nodes.summary: Builds and evaluates query predicates ($in, $nin, $like, $gt, $regex, etc.) used by the in-memory database to filter documents.

nodes.name: createPredicates
nodes.summary: Compiles a query object into a set of predicate functions keyed by attribute for efficient document matching.

nodes.name: proxy.ts
nodes.summary: Provides JavaScript Proxy factories that present documents as their mixin types and produce frozen, read-only document views.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ES Proxy traps to overlay mixin properties and enforce immutability without copying the underlying document.

nodes.name: _createMixinProxy
nodes.summary: Creates a Proxy that overlays a mixin's attributes onto a base document, redirecting reads to the mixin namespace.

nodes.name: query.ts
nodes.summary: Core query-matching and sorting engine: evaluates documents against query objects, resolves dotted/mixin keys, and applies multi-field sorting with enum ordering.

nodes.name: matchQuery
nodes.summary: Filters a document set by evaluating each document against a query, applying predicates and property checks.

nodes.name: resultSort
nodes.summary: Sorts a result set by a multi-field sort spec, honoring enum-based ordering and ascending/descending directions.

nodes.name: findProperty
nodes.summary: Resolves a property value for a set of documents by a (possibly nested) key, used during query matching.

nodes.name: server.ts
nodes.summary: Defines server-side core interfaces and types (session/context, low-level storage adapters) bridging the core model to the backend server runtime.

nodes.name: status.ts
nodes.summary: Declares status-related types and the DOMAIN_STATUS domain constant for status documents.

nodes.name: storage.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the Storage abstraction interfaces (findAll/tx/loadChunk/upload) and related query/options types that the client and server implementations conform to.

nodes.name: time.ts
nodes.summary: Date/time helper functions for deriving day and hour buckets and comparing timestamps for grouping and display.

nodes.name: tx.ts
nodes.summary: Core transaction model: defines all Tx types (create/update/remove/mixin/apply), the TxProcessor for applying them to documents, and the TxFactory for constructing transactions.
nodes.languageNotes: Heart of the transaction-sourced model — every document mutation flows through these Tx types and TxProcessor.

nodes.name: TxFactory

nodes.name: compact.rs
nodes.summary: Background compaction subsystem with ingest and compact worker tasks that merge many object parts into a single consolidated blob to keep object part counts bounded.

nodes.name: run_ingest_worker

nodes.name: none_match

nodes.name: V1__initial.sql
nodes.summary: Initial Flyway migration for the hulylake server, creating the core blob and object tables with their indexes for the object storage layer.
nodes.languageNotes: Flyway versioned migration (V1__) using PostgreSQL types: uuid for workspace, jsonb for object data, bytea for inline binary payloads.

nodes.name: blob
nodes.summary: Content-addressable blob table mapping a unique key to a unique content hash, backed by unique indexes on both columns.

nodes.name: object
nodes.summary: Workspace-scoped object table storing partitioned jsonb data and optional inline binary content, keyed by (workspace, key, part).

nodes.name: allSchema.sql
nodes.summary: Global migration that iterates every public base table with a jsonb 'data' column and adds a generated '%hash%' text column populated from data->>'%hash%' for change-detection.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a PL/pgSQL DO block with dynamic EXECUTE format() to apply a column addition across all tables generically.

nodes.name: calendarSchema.sql
nodes.summary: Migration adding a typed 'hidden' boolean column to the calendar table, backfilled from the jsonb data->>'hidden' value.

nodes.name: dncSchema.sql
nodes.summary: Migration restructuring the notification_dnc (do-not-contact) table: adds objectId, objectClass and user columns from jsonb data, drops attachedTo, and enforces NOT NULL constraints.

nodes.name: eventSchema.sql
nodes.summary: Migration adding typed date, dueDate, calendar and participants columns to the event table, backfilled from the jsonb data field including a participants text[] array extraction.

nodes.name: notificationSchema.sql
nodes.summary: Migration adding typed isViewed, archived and user columns to the notification table from jsonb data, dropping attachedTo, and enforcing NOT NULL constraints.

nodes.name: spaceSchema.sql
nodes.summary: Migration adding a typed 'archived' boolean column to the space table, backfilled from the jsonb data->>'archived' value.

nodes.name: timeSchema.sql
nodes.summary: Migration adding typed workslots, doneOn, rank and user columns to the time table, all backfilled from the corresponding jsonb data fields.

nodes.name: txSchema.sql
nodes.summary: Migration adding typed objectSpace, objectId and attachedTo columns to the transaction (tx) table from jsonb data, with a NOT NULL constraint on objectSpace.

nodes.name: uncSchema.sql
nodes.summary: Migration restructuring the notification_user table: adds a typed user column from jsonb data, drops attachedTo, and enforces a NOT NULL constraint.

nodes.summary: Generates daily recurrence occurrence timestamps honoring interval and BYSETPOS constraints.

nodes.name: generateWeeklyValues
nodes.summary: Generates weekly recurrence occurrence timestamps honoring BYDAY weekday matching and BYSETPOS within each week window.

nodes.summary: Determines whether a date satisfies a BYDAY constraint, supporting ordinal-prefixed weekdays and negative positions within the month.

nodes.name: getNegativePosition
nodes.summary: Computes whether a date is the Nth-from-last occurrence of a given weekday within its month for negative BYDAY positions.

nodes.name: generateMonthlyValues
nodes.summary: Generates monthly recurrence occurrence timestamps, building candidate dates from BYDAY/BYMONTHDAY and filtering via BYSETPOS.

nodes.name: generateYearlyValues
nodes.summary: Generates yearly recurrence occurrence timestamps, filtering candidate dates by BYMONTH, BYMONTHDAY, BYYEARDAY, BYWEEKNO, BYDAY and BYSETPOS.

layers.name: Core Platform
layers.description: Foundational data model and runtime: transaction-sourced documents (Tx/Doc/Class), the plugin/resource platform, RPC, the WebSocket client and client-resources, the typed API client, reactive query, text model, ranking, account/token auth. This is the heart a mobile client integrates with.

layers.name: Server Foundation
layers.description: Server-side core: storage adapters (Mongo, Postgres, S3, MinIO, Elastic, datalake), pipeline middleware, collaboration, and the server runtime contracts that back the platform.

layers.name: Communication Foundation
layers.description: Messaging/communication subsystem: shared types, client-query, server processor, cockroach store, and SDK types powering chat/notifications.

layers.name: Network Foundation
layers.description: Low-level networking: the network pod, backrpc transport, and client/server network primitives that move traffic between services.

layers.name: Stream & Media (Go)
layers.description: Go-based media streaming foundation: profiles, resolution conversion, media-convert scheduling, tracing, tokens, and queue workers.

layers.name: Object Storage Foundation
layers.description: Huly object-storage services: hulylake (blob lake) and hulypulse (presence/pulse) clients and servers.

layers.name: Build & Utils Foundation
layers.description: Shared build rig (platform-rig/Heft profiles), UI test harness, and cross-cutting utility packages.

layers.name: Data Models
layers.description: Declarative domain models (TxModel builders) for every Huly application — tracker, contact, chunter, recruit, HR, documents, etc. — that define classes, mixins, and default data.

layers.name: UI Component Packages
layers.description: Reusable Svelte UI building blocks and presentation infrastructure: the ui kit, presentation/client glue, theme, panel, kanban, text editors.

layers.name: Client Plugins
layers.description: Front-end application plugins (the *-resources Svelte modules and plugin definitions) implementing each product feature: tracker, chunter, contact, cards, love, training, controlled-documents, settings, workbench, login, and more.

layers.name: Server Plugins
layers.description: Server-side counterparts of the application plugins: trigger/notification/collaboration logic that runs in the backend pipeline.

layers.name: Backend Services
layers.description: Standalone backend microservices: github integration, mail, calendar, ai-bot, datalake, analytics-collector, sign, and others.

layers.name: Deployable Pods
layers.description: Deployable backend process bundles (pods) that compose foundations/services into runnable server processes.

layers.name: Server Runtime
layers.description: The front/server runtime layer that serves the web client and brokers requests.

layers.name: Desktop Application
layers.description: Electron desktop application main and renderer processes plus packaging configuration (desktop, desktop-package, qms-desktop-package).

layers.name: Dev Tooling
layers.description: Developer tooling and repo scripts: the dev tool CLI, import tools, storybook, prod harness, and common Rush/build scripts.

layers.name: Tests & QA Harness
layers.description: End-to-end and sanity test suites and their docker/provisioning harnesses (tests, ws-tests, qms-tests).

layers.name: Project Templates
layers.description: Scaffolding templates for new platform packages and plugins.

layers.name: Documentation
layers.description: Top-level project documentation and guides.

layers.name: Other
layers.description: Files not matched by a specific architectural layer (root-level configs and miscellany).

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README and architecture overview to understand what the Huly Platform is: a framework for business apps (Chat, Project Management, CRM, HRM, ATS) built on a shared transaction-sourced data model and a plugin architecture.

tour.title: The Core Data Model
tour.description: Everything in Huly is a Doc belonging to a Class. classes.ts defines Doc/Class/Mixin and the base type system; hierarchy.ts implements the runtime class hierarchy used to resolve inheritance and mixins. A client must understand these to read any object.

tour.title: Transactions — the Source of Truth
tour.description: State is never mutated in place; it is derived from a stream of transactions. tx.ts defines TxCreateDoc/TxUpdateDoc/TxRemoveDoc and friends. Sending a tx is how a client writes data — the cornerstone of the protocol.

tour.title: Reading Data: Storage & findAll
tour.description: storage.ts declares the Storage/low-level read contract (findAll/findOne with Query and FindOptions), and memdb.ts is the in-memory model that applies transactions and answers queries. This findAll + tx pair is the entire read/write surface.

tour.title: The Client Interface
tour.description: client.ts defines the Client abstraction a consumer holds — combining findAll/findOne reads with tx writes and model access. This is the interface a mobile client ultimately programs against.

tour.title: The Platform: Plugins & Resources
tour.description: platform.ts is the dependency-injection and plugin system. Functionality is registered as Resources behind string ids and resolved lazily, letting the same core host many apps. Understanding resource resolution explains how features are wired.

tour.title: The Wire Protocol (RPC)
tour.description: rpc encodes requests/responses exchanged with the server. This is the serialization layer a non-JS mobile client must reimplement or bridge to talk over the WebSocket.

tour.title: Authentication: Account & Token
tour.description: Before connecting, a client authenticates with the account service and obtains a token. account-client wraps account operations; token mints/validates the JWT used on the WebSocket handshake.

tour.title: Connecting: The WebSocket Client
tour.description: client establishes the WebSocket connection to the transactor and implements the ClientConnection (findAll/tx over the wire). client-resources bootstraps it as a platform resource. This is the concrete transport a mobile app drives.

tour.title: Live Queries
tour.description: query implements LiveQuery: a reactive layer that keeps result sets in sync by listening to the transaction stream. This is how UIs (and a reactive mobile client) stay live without polling.

tour.title: The Typed API Client
tour.description: api-client is the high-level, typed entry point the README recommends for programmatic integrations — exactly the surface a mobile client or backend integration would build on, hiding the raw tx/findAll plumbing.

tour.title: The Server Side
tour.description: foundations/server/packages/server is the transactor pipeline that accepts client connections, applies transactions through middleware, and persists them via storage adapters — the other end of everything above.

tour.title: Declarative Models
tour.description: models/core declares the actual classes/mixins/data using the model builder. Each Huly app ships a model module; this is where the abstract type system becomes concrete domain schema.
